description: This file defines a Java interface 'SignalEnrichmentFacade' within the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.signalenrichment'. The interface provides an asynchronous method to retrieve partial information about a 'Thing' based on its ID, selected JSON fields, headers, and an optional signal context. The purpose is to support signal enrichment operations by fetching necessary data from various sources asynchronously.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentFacade
classes.description: Asynchronous interface for retrieving parts of 'Thing' objects for signal enrichment purposes. It defines a method to asynchronously fetch selected fields of a 'Thing' identified by 'ThingId', considering headers and optional signal context.

methods.name: retrievePartialThing
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves specified parts of a 'Thing' identified by 'thingId'. Takes JSON field selectors, headers, and an optional signal that triggered the retrieval, returning a future that completes with a 'JsonObject' containing the requested data or fails with an error.
